label: Relational rank
title: Can available spatial directions be separated from directions a law actually uses?
summary: Two representation-relative ranks separate nontrivial translation directions of a state family from essential displacement directions of a local law. Exact replay of the ordered-axis ECA constructor confirms a product theorem and shows that target causal rank adds no classification beyond source essentiality.
takeaway: Available translation rank and law-used causal rank are distinct resources, but neither is promoted to intrinsic dimension; for the accepted axial constructor the causal-rank census is fully determined by the source dependency pattern.
